iii_b_critical_path_note: Only IB02 (q-generalized path and qualification primitive) and IB03 (q=0.05 bit-identity regression fixture) touch III-A code. Both are A1 tasks and both MUST land BEFORE I02 - not merely before III-A P1 - because III-A qualification gate 12 depends on them. Everything else in III-B (IB01, IB04-IB20) is off the III-A critical path and may proceed in parallel or be abandoned at any drop level without touching III-A.
dependency_ordering_note: I02 depends on the III-B-authored IMPLEMENTATION tasks IB02 and IB03. It depends on no III-B RUNTIME STAGE (no B-GEN, B-PILOT, B-GATE, B-CAP, B-EXT, B-ORC, B-U2, B-U3 or B-LOCK artifact). The III-A invariant forbids the latter, not the former: gate 12 is evaluated entirely inside A1 from seeds, geometry and timing, and the resulting III-A cohort is identical whether III-B later runs, skips, fails or is dropped.
